items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I worked in his band for quite a while... Teddy was working in Cumberton Street. Yeah, his father, Amos.

ctx.x: Oh, that's Amos Riley. Amos Riley. Teddy Riley. Teddy Riley's dad.

I guess so. Yeah, look, Teddy was working in Cumberton Street. Yeah, his father, Amos. I worked in his band for quite a while, I mean, second and third trumpet. Did you ever work with the two-lane band? No, no, no, never worked with him. When were you born in Y.A.? Huh? When were you born? 1893. In Henry Orleans? Well, St. Bernard Parish, it's the next parish down here. What town? A plantation or town or a... No, St. Bernard Parish in town, that's the city part.
Yeah. But you were born, you weren't born on a plantation? No, no. What's your birthday exactly? What's your birthday?
